label: Arm bounce
spokenPrompt: Let your arm bounce, soft and loose, like a bouncy ball.
praiseLines: Your arm bounced so softly!
Loose and bouncy on every note!
I saw your arm float up like a ball after each note.
Boing, boing! What a bouncy arm!

label: Rainbow hand
spokenPrompt: Keep your rainbow hand, nice and round.
praiseLines: Your rainbow hand stayed round the whole time!
I saw a perfect rainbow over the keys!
Your fingers stood up tall like a rainbow bridge.
Round hand, all the way to the last note!

label: Soft sound
spokenPrompt: Make a soft, gentle sound, like a feather.
praiseLines: That was so soft, like a feather landing!
You made a gentle sound on every note.
Your quiet notes were beautiful.
I had to lean in to hear it. So soft!

label: Steady beat
spokenPrompt: Keep a steady beat, like a ticking clock.
praiseLines: Your beat was steady like a clock!
Every note came right on time.
You kept the beat all the way through.
Tick, tock, tick, tock. So steady!

label: Eyes on the keys
spokenPrompt: Keep your eyes on the keys.
praiseLines: Your eyes stayed on the keys the whole time!
You watched your fingers like a detective.
Great looking! You found every key.
Eagle eyes on every note!

label: Relaxed thumb
spokenPrompt: Let your thumb be soft and relaxed.
praiseLines: Your thumb stayed soft and floppy. Nice!
What a relaxed thumb!
Your thumb played gently on its side.
Soft thumb the whole way!

label: Posture
spokenPrompt: Sit up tall like a tree.
praiseLines: You sat up tall like a tree!
Great sitting! Feet still and back tall.
You looked like a real concert pianist.
Tall and strong the whole time!
